items.author: Kerith Burke
items.body_excerpt:
Mike Dunleavy spoke to reporters for about 30 mins today. He said “winning now is priority number one.”

Can this roster win a championship? “We need to stay healthy, and then we need to evaluate and see where we're at. And if we need to get better, I know we can get better. So there's a path.”
